Keeping the practice running smoothly There's a lot that happens behind the scenes in General Practice. You'll support the day-to-day administration that helps our clinical teams deliver care, including managing emails, correspondence, patient records and other administrative tasks. You'll need to be comfortable juggling different priorities while maintaining accuracy and confidentiality. Managing appointments and patient requests You'll book, amend and cancel appointments, helping us make the best use of the clinical time available. You'll also deal appropriately with urgent appointment requests and home visit requests, following practice procedures to make sure information reaches the right clinical colleague. Supporting prescriptions and referrals You'll support the processing of repeat prescription requests in line with practice procedures and help ensure they're dealt with efficiently. Managing patient information Accurate information is essential to safe patient care.
